title: Private Service Edge Software by Platform

blocks.text: Private Service Edges for Private Access (ZPA) are supported on many different platforms. Each supported platform has a Private Service Edge image you can use to deploy Private Service Edges on that platform. To learn more, see Private Service Edge Deployment Guides for Supported Platforms for detailed deployment instructions.
The following platforms support Private Service Edge software packages. Where applicable, see the download links for images, public keys, and checksums.

table: Zscaler Private Access - AWS Marketplace (STIG Image)
Zscaler Private Access- GCP Marketplace (STIG Image)
Zscaler Private Access - Azure Marketplace (STIG Image)
The following RHEL 9 Private Service Edge images are available for Microsoft Azure Local: VHDX VHDX checksum
The following RHEL 9 Private Service Edge images are available for Microsoft Hyper-V: VHDX VHDX checksum

The following RPM packages are supported on RHEL Private Service Edge deployments: RHEL 8-based: RPM package GPG public key RHEL 9-based: RPM package GPG public key You must have the RHEL operating system deployed and running.
